series.name: SUN2000-(8KTL...20KTL)-M0 LED1/LED2/LED3 indicator states (Table 2-2 LED indicator description)
series.notes: LED behaviour table, NOT a numbered fault-code table. Codes here are the physical LED state strings. Red rows are generic alarm indications with no alarm ID - the technician must open the FusionSolar/SUN2000 app to get the actual numeric alarm. Distinct from SERIES 4 (USL0 LEDs, which add orange backup-mode rows) and SERIES 10 (M2/MG 4-indicator panel).

codes.code: LED1 Steady green + LED2 Steady green
aliases: LED1 Steady green + LED2 Steady green

title.ur: Grid-tied mode mein chal raha hai (normal)

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid green: the inverter is exporting to the grid normally.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid green: inverter normally grid mein power de raha hai.

causes.en: Normal operation, AC and DC both live.
causes.ur: Normal operation, AC aur DC dono live hain.

solutions.en: No action needed; this is the healthy state.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi; yeh healthy state hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

meaning.en: Both running LEDs off - the DC input is not live. The AC may still be on, so check the external AC switch.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs off - DC input live nahi hai. AC ab bhi on ho sakta hai, is liye external AC switch check karein.

causes.en: DC switch off, or PV voltage below the MPPT startup threshold (night/no irradiance).
causes.ur: DC switch off hai, ya PV voltage MPPT startup threshold se kam hai (raat/irradiance nahi).

solutions.en: Note the manual caveat: the AC may be on. Verify the external AC switch position before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: Manual ka note yaad rakhein: AC on ho sakta hai. DC side chhune se pehle external AC switch ki position verify karein.

solutions.en: At night both LEDs being off is normal; re-check after sunrise.
solutions.ur: Raat mein dono LEDs off hona normal hai; sunrise ke baad dobara check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

codes.code: LED1 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)
aliases: LED1 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)

title.ur: DC environmental alarm (PV side ka masla)

meaning.en: LED1 blinking fast red marks an environmental (external) fault on the DC/PV side. The numeric code is in the app.
meaning.ur: LED1 fast red blink DC/PV side ka environmental (external) fault batata hai. Numeric code app mein hota hai.

causes.en: PV string wiring, polarity or insulation problem on the DC side.
causes.ur: PV string wiring, polarity ya insulation ka masla DC side par.

causes.en: PV string open-circuit voltage too high or too low.
causes.ur: PV string open-circuit voltage bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai.

solutions.en: Connect with the FusionSolar app to read the numeric alarm ID before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle FusionSolar app se connect karke numeric alarm ID padh lein.

solutions.en: Open the app's DC-environmental troubleshooting page; it guides the string to check.
solutions.ur: App ka DC-environmental troubleshooting page kholein; yeh check karne wali string batata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before re-torquing MC4 connectors or re-seating strings.
solutions.ur: MC4 connectors dobara torque karne ya strings dobara lagane se pehle AC aur PV disconnect karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 blinking red at short intervals (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

codes.code: LED2 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)
aliases: LED2 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)

meaning.en: LED2 blinking fast red marks an environmental (external) fault on the AC/grid side. The numeric code is in the app.
meaning.ur: LED2 fast red blink AC/grid side ka environmental (external) fault batata hai. Numeric code app mein hota hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage, frequency or phase imbalance outside the allowed window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage, frequency ya phase imbalance allowed window se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC switch open or grid outage.
causes.ur: AC switch khula hai ya grid outage hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm ID in the app; it distinguishes 2032-2038 grid alarms from 2051/2061 earth alarms.
solutions.ur: App mein numeric alarm ID padhein; yeh 2032-2038 grid alarms ko 2051/2061 earth alarms se alag karta hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminals before assuming the inverter is at fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko fault na samajhein, pehle AC terminals par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED2 blinking red at short intervals (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

codes.code: LED1 Steady red + LED2 Steady red
aliases: LED1 Steady red + LED2 Steady red

meaning.en: A fault exists inside the inverter; both running LEDs are solid red.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar fault hai; dono running LEDs solid red hain.

causes.en: Internal device fault such as alarm 2064 Device Fault.
causes.ur: Internal device fault, maslan alarm 2064 Device Fault.

causes.en: Internal insulation or grounding fault such as 2051, 2061 or 2062.
causes.ur: Internal insulation ya grounding fault, maslan 2051, 2061 ya 2062.

solutions.en: Get the numeric alarm ID from the app first - steady red alone does not identify the fault.
solutions.ur: Pehle app se numeric alarm ID lein - sirf steady red fault ki pehchan nahi karta.

solutions.en: Power off in the documented order (AC output switch, then DC input switch) and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Documented order se band karein (AC output switch, phir DC input switch) aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Record the alarm ID and Cause ID before restarting; they are what Huawei support needs.
solutions.ur: Restart karne se pehle alarm ID aur Cause ID note karein; Huawei support ko yahi chahiye hote hain.

codes.blinkPattern: LED1 steady red, LED2 steady red

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

meaning.en: The comms LED is off - the management system is not talking to the inverter.
meaning.ur: Comms LED off hai - management system inverter se baat nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Smart Dongle or WiFi not fitted, or the network link is down.
causes.ur: Smart Dongle ya WiFi nahi laga, ya network link down hai.

causes.en: The inverter is fully powered down.

solutions.en: If the unit is generating, check the dongle LEDs and the router/AP it is registered to.
solutions.ur: Agar unit generate kar raha hai to dongle LEDs aur uska registered router/AP check karein.

solutions.en: If the unit is off, use a multimeter to confirm whether PV and AC are actually energised before assuming a comms fault.
solutions.ur: Agar unit off hai to comms fault maan lene se pehle multimeter se confirm karein ke PV aur AC actually energized hain ya nahi.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description
